name: Rival Go Away
steps: The Old Man: Drag camera phone → reveal cheating photo → wife drags him away.
The Bragger: Tap his phone → ex shows up in message → he leaves happy.
The Flamer: Drag chili oil into his drink → he breathes fire and runs.
The Clean Freak: Tap tray → wine spills on suit → he leaves to change.
The Clumsy One: Tap bucket → water spill → he slips and falls.
The Gym Bro: Drag lipstick onto him → boyfriend appears → pulls him away.
The Fake Doctor: Swipe curtain → nurse appears → drags him off.
The Secretly Married Man: Tap pocket → marriage certificate revealed → he leaves in shame.
